channel.title: Steam Deck HQ - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Steam Deck HQ (steamdeckhq.com)

item.title: Death Stranding 2 Becomes Playable On Steam Deck With The Eclipse Mod - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Death Stranding 2 may not have released in a playable state on the Steam Deck, but thanks to one mod, it can be very enjoyable on the Deck so far.

item.title: Dark Scrolls Preview - A Surprisingly Clear Chaotic Shoot 'Em Up - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Dark Scrolls is shaping up to be a surprisingly clear chaotic shoot 'em up side-scroller that has the perfect kind of tension all throughout.

item.title: All The Steam Spring Sale 2026 Games That Are 90% Off Or More - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Here are all the games from the Steam Spring Sale that are 90% off or more!

item.title: Bomberman 64 Got A Native PC Port That's Perfect For Steam Deck - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Bomberman 64 got a new native PC port, giving it wonderful new features, better support, and it's nearly flawless on the Steam Deck.

item.title: EmuDeck Goes Into Beta For Android Devices, Making Emulation Setup Simple - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: EmuDeck is now in beta on Android devices, and despite some small issues, it makes setting up emulation on retro handhelds significantly easier.

item.title: AYANEO Increasing Handheld Prices "Soon" Due To Rising Storage Component Costs - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: AYANEO sent out an email mentioning that pricing on their handhelds will be rising soon, and some handhelds will be temporarily discontinued.

item.title: GreenManGaming's Team17 Collection Bundle Has 8 Amazing Steam Deck-Friendly Games - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: GreenManGaming's Team17 Collection bundle is a great group of discounted games that are all amazing to play on the Steam Deck.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 Hits Number 1 On The Top 20 Most Played Steam Deck Games of March 2026 - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Resident Evil Requiem and Slay the Spire 2 have debuted on the Top 20 Most Played Steam Deck Games list of March 2026.

item.title: The Original Resident Evil Titles Release On Steam, But They Have Trouble On Steam Deck - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: The original versions of Resident Evil 1, 2, and 3 have arrived on Steam, but they require some work to run on Steam Deck.

item.title: dBrand's Touch Grass Steam Deck Skin Makes A Return For April Fools - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: dBrand has brought back the Touch Grass Steam Deck skin from last year, giving us a chance to get connected with nature while gaming.

item.title: Humble's Strategic Minds Bundle Has 7 Incredible Experiences For The Steam Deck - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Humble's Strategic Minds bundle is filled with 7 distinct games, like Valkyria Chronicles 4, that are all amazing on the Steam Deck.

item.title: Death Stranding 2 Gets Huge Steam Deck Performance Improvements With Patch 1.2 - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: Death Stranding 2's new 1.2 update improves performance on the Steam Deck by a large margin, getting closer to a stable 30 FPS.

item.title: Free Games + Amazon Prime For Your Steam Deck and Handhelds - 4/2/26: - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: There are some intriguing new free games to add to our Steam Deck libraries, including TOMAK, Depths of Horror: Mushroom Day, and more.

item.title: The Entire Jak And Daxter Trilogy Now Have Native PC Ports, And They Are Great on Steam Deck - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: The Jak and Daxter trilogy can now be fully played through native PC ports due to Jak 3 now being playable to the public, and they are great on Steam Deck.

item.title: New Steam Deck Beta Client Update Adds Remote Download Management - Steam Deck HQ
item.description: A new Steam Deck Beta Client update was released that allows us to remotely manage downloads of other Steam Clients we are logged into.
